future_candidate_margin.error_metrics: aggregate normalized MAE plus ratified critical aggregate error cells
future_candidate_margin.rule: point improvement at least baseline radius and paired LCB95 above zero, with Holm-corrected safety/coverage noninferiority

headroom.definition: h = selected deterministic comparator aggregate normalized MAE minus oracle diagnostic error on identical validation rows

ridge_replacement: positive Holm-surviving aggregate improvement with LCB95 above zero
baseline.validation_access: one immutable access after source, corpus, split, timing, baseline and evaluator bytes are frozen

required_exact_bindings_before_approval: ratified pilot profile/action packet semantic and raw byte identities
pilot identity and matched-control record contract identities
evaluator and timing implementation source-blob manifest identities
compact and full-reference ridge source-blob manifest identities

bootstrap.p_value: Boundary-centered stratified whole-cluster bootstrap with plus-one correction over 10001.
bootstrap.seed: SHA256(domain NUL policy_sha256_bytes exact_input_evidence_sha256_bytes analysis_id_utf8) first 16 bytes big-endian

critical_inferential_universe.unsupported_claim: STOP_UNDERPOWERED and claim remains in family

folds.inner_assignment: Within each outer-training stratum rank its four cluster IDs by HMAC-SHA256(key=policy_sha256 bytes, message=aeolus-forecast-d2-inner-v1 NUL outer_fold NUL stratum NUL family_cluster_id), tie by family_cluster_id; rank j is inner fold j.
folds.outer_assignment: Within each stratum rank the five cluster IDs by HMAC-SHA256(key=policy_sha256 bytes, message=aeolus-forecast-d2-outer-v1 NUL stratum NUL family_cluster_id), tie by family_cluster_id; rank k is outer fold k.

matched_action_and_noise.control: Same member, repetition, anchor, source prefix, scenario bytes, random seed and reset nonce; proposal variant uses one normal proposal at anchor and control variant uses NO_PROPOSAL at that anchor; both use NO_PROPOSAL thereafter.
matched_action_and_noise.control_reuse: One matched NO_PROPOSAL continuation per member/repetition/anchor is reused across the four proposal contrasts.
matched_action_and_noise.effect: Per cluster and action, mean normalized absolute action-versus-control future difference minus mean normalized absolute control-repetition difference.
matched_action_and_noise.noise_floor: Compare the two matched NO_PROPOSAL repetition outcomes for the same cluster/member/anchor using the same supported target-offset cells.
matched_action_and_noise.rule: For every timing pair and each of four actions, one-sided LCB95 must exceed 0.02 and the Holm-adjusted boundary test must pass.

metric_semantics.abstention: Counts as no crossing prediction, therefore FN for positive truth and TN for negative truth, and reduces coverage.
metric_semantics.harmful_crossing: Inclusive envelope boundary: truth <= lower or truth >= upper is harmful; pre-existing anchor harm is excluded from new-crossing truth and separately reported.

pilot.permanent_exclusion_scope: cluster, family, member, repetition, anchor, action, control, witness, trace and all derived identities

selection: For each H choose W=4 only if admissible and equivalent to W=8 and W=16.
Otherwise choose W=8 only if admissible and equivalent to W=16.
Select the largest H with a selected W.
If no H has a selected W emit STOP_NO_DEFENSIBLE_TIMING.

target_scale.heldout_outside_training_percentiles: evaluate without clipping and report descriptively
